articles.title: Iranian missiles intercepted over Saudi, UAE, drones launched at Qatar
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Defense successfully intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles targeting Prince Sultan Air Base in al-Kharj. This incident highlights persistent regional tensions, particularly amid broader geopolitical dynamics involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. Such events underscore the critical importance of robust air defense systems and geopolitical awareness for understanding West Asian security.

articles.title: Mortar shell defused along LoC in J-K's Poonch
articles.summary: Security forces successfully defused a live mortar shell discovered in a forward village near the Line of Control (LoC) in Poonch district, Jammu and Kashmir, on Saturday. This swift action prevented potential casualties and damage in the sensitive border area. Such discoveries underscore the constant vigilance required by personnel to ensure safety for residents living in villages along the highly militarized frontier.

articles.title: Caught between Iran and Saudi Arabia, can Pakistan stay neutral for long?
articles.summary: A devastating war involving US-Israel attacks on Iran has led to over a thousand casualties, including Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. Iranian missile responses signify a severe escalation of this international conflict. This major development indicates a critical shift in Middle Eastern geopolitics, carrying potentially wide-ranging global implications that warrant urgent diplomatic and strategic analysis.
